title: Receiver provenance is bulk-joined onto a ConfigRevision, not passed per-call
answers: Why is a receiver's Provenance empty/ProvenanceNone when I read it from a ConfigRevision?
How do I get the correct provisioning Provenance on a receiver read from alertmanager config?
GetReceiver/GetReceivers no longer take a provenances map argument
body: Receiver Provenance is no longer threaded as a `provenances map[string]models.Provenance` parameter through ConfigRevision.GetReceiver/GetReceivers. Instead it must be joined onto the whole revision up front via rev.AssignReceiverProvenances(provenances) (pkg/services/ngalert/notifier/legacy_storage/receivers.go:AssignReceiverProvenances), which mutates every v1.PostableApiReceiver.Provenance in rev.Config.Receivers in place. ReceiverService callers must call the private helper assignProvenance(ctx, orgID, revision) (pkg/services/ngalert/notifier/receiver_svc.go:assignProvenance) before any GetReceiver/GetReceivers call, or returned receivers will have the wrong/default Provenance. If skipped, provisioning-protection logic (export/edit guards keyed on Provenance) silently sees the wrong value.
applies: Any code path in notifier/legacy_storage or provisioning that reads receivers out of a ConfigRevision and needs correct Provenance.
says: Why is receiver provenance empty when read from configuration?
Receiver provenance shows none instead of actual provisioning source.
How can I verify receivers have correct provisioning information?
Receiver provenance missing after reading from alertmanager configuration.
I need the correct provisioning source shown on receivers.
search: Receiver provenance is no longer threaded as a per-call parameter but is bulk-joined onto a ConfigRevision via rev.AssignReceiverProvenances(provenances), which mutates every v1.PostableApiReceiver.Provenance in place. ReceiverService callers must invoke the private helper assignProvenance(ctx, orgID, revision) before any GetReceiver/GetReceivers call; if skipped, receivers are returned with wrong/default provenance values. This is critical because provisioning-protection logic (export/edit guards) is keyed on the provenance value and silently sees the wrong result if assignProvenance is not called first. The pattern applies to any code path in notifier/legacy_storage or provisioning that reads receivers out of a ConfigRevision and needs correct provenance.
